response.sql:
WITH rating_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), rating_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS overall_average
  FROM rating_rentals
)
SELECT AVG(rr.rental_count) AS average_for_above_average_ratings,
       AVG(rr.rental_count - ra.overall_average) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM rating_rentals rr
CROSS JOIN rating_averages ra
WHERE rr.rental_count > ra.overall_average

assumptions.assumption: Each rating’s rental figure is the total number of rental records across all inventory copies of films with that rating; the overall average is the unweighted mean of the five rating totals.
